messages.text: Texans beat Jags in final seconds of Wembley thriller

metadata.summary: Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked a 49-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Houston Texans to a 34-31 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in a thriller at Wembley Stadium on Sunday.
metadata.content: NFL London games 2026: Houston Texans beat Jacksonville Jaguars after Ka'imi Fairbairn's walk-off field goal | NFL News | Sky Sports Skip to main content NFL London games 2026: Houston Texans beat Jacksonville Jaguars after Ka'imi Fairbairn's walk-off field goal CJ Stroud throws three touchdown passes as the Houston Texans beat the Jacksonville Jaguars thanks to a game-winning field goal from Ka'imi Fairbairn in the final seconds at Wembley Stadium; Travis Hunter records touchdown and interception for Jaguars By Cam Hogwood at Wembley Stadium Sunday 18 October 2026 18:14, UK Image: Houston Texans place kicker Ka'imi Fairbairn (15), top center, celebrates with teammates after scoring the game winning field goal during an NFL football game against Jacksonville Jaguars in London, Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026. (AP Photo/Kin Cheung) Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked a 49-yard field goal as time expired to lift the Houston Texans to a 34-31 victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars in a thriller at Wembley Stadium on Sunday. It was a game that began with referee Larry Smith being carted off with a non-contact injury in the opening seconds. A game that spent its interval staging on-field Corgi races. And a game that concluded with another dose of boot-fuelled drama following Cam Little's last-second winner against the Philadelphia Eagles at Tottenham the previous week. Texans quarterback CJ Stroud threw for 312 yards and three touchdowns while Jaylin Noel led his side with four receptions for 107 yards

messages.text: Britain's Kartal misses out on maiden WTA 1000 title in Wuhan

metadata.summary: Britain's Sonay Kartal was beaten in a deciding set by Poland's Maja Chwalinska in a pulsating Wuhan Open final.
metadata.content: Sonay Kartal misses out on maiden WTA 1000 title in Wuhan Open final defeat to Maja Chwalinska | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Sonay Kartal misses out on maiden WTA 1000 title in Wuhan Open final defeat to Maja Chwalinska Britain's Sonay Kartal missed out on a maiden WTA 1000 title after losing to Maja Chwalinska in the Wuhan Open final; Kartal had won the opening set but French Open runner-up Chwalinska brilliantly fought back to win in three sets Nigel Chiu Sports Journalist @NigelCJourno Sunday 18 October 2026 15:03, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Highlights of the Wuhan Open final between Sonay Kartal and Maja Chwalinska. Britain's Sonay Kartal was beaten in a deciding set by Poland's Maja Chwalinska in a pulsating Wuhan Open final. Kartal led by a set and a break as she looked to become just the second Briton, after Johanna Konta, to win a WTA 1000 title but French Open finalist Chwalinska produced a superb display to fight back and win 2-6 6-4 6-2. Nevertheless, it has still been a remarkable week for Kartal, the best in her career so far, after only returning to the tour earlier this month following a six-month lay-off due to a back injury.
